title: Hip & Leg Flexibility - A
texts: Box Split, Butterfly, Hip Flexor Stretch, and High Step

Complete 4 sets of each of the following static positions.  For exercises targeted one side of the body at a time - two reps will be included.

Hold the most stretched position possible where you feel slight discomfort but not pain.  To help maintain flexibility, each position should be held for 30 seconds.  

Complete all sets of each position before moving to the next exercise, resting for 10 seconds between reps, 1 minute between sets, and 2 minutes between exercises.
